title: Simplification engine: subsumed static analysis over the whole repository, candidates only
summary: orchestrate simplify builds a component view from the existing import graph and Git history and proposes dead-module, unused-public-function, duplicate-body, dependency-removal and prior-art replace/borrow candidates; it deletes nothing. Candidates become IMP records and are applied in separate passes with tests (IMP-0010, IMP-0011).

prior_art.checked: discovery for dead code and duplicate detection: vulture, deadcode, dead, Skylos, PyChase (all now in the registry)
prior_art.found: vulture is the reference name-usage heuristic; PyChase-style AST normalization for clones
prior_art.reused: vulture's heuristic (validated 3/3 against vulture itself), AST-normalization idea
prior_art.why_custom: the engine must join import graph, tests, Git churn and the prior-art registry, which no single tool does; vulture stays an optional external cross-check
